title: MPK Native Qwen3 0.6B Token Viewer Import
command: Normalize native-token2.json with mpk_native_token_capture.py, then import native-token2-paper-results.json through paper_baseline_results_update.py.
observation: The native MPK torch bring-up artifact imported one llm_serving_decode viewer row with prompt/decode tokens, end-to-end latency, inter-token latency, and output-token throughput. This is native bring-up evidence only, not persistent-kernel paper evidence.
